subject: MPA: acceptance cadence + SOC 2/SIG archive questions
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fidorbank.com>, Tom Mueller <tom.mueller@fidorbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MPA: acceptance cadence + SOC 2/SIG archive questions

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. To keep momentum toward your end-of-year procurement window, I sketched a tight mutual action plan focused on the security/compliance gates we discussed (SOC 2 artifacts, SIG/CAIQ, DPA and data retention). Please see the attached proposed MPA and the SOC 2 evidence matrix for our recommended milestones.

Quick summary of asks so we can finalize the MAP and lock a close date: 
- Target close: 2025-12-24 (aiming for contract signature + minimal provisioning) — is this still realistic on your side?
- SOC 2: we can provide artifact snapshots (system descriptions, control mappings, SOC report excerpt). Please confirm which artifacts your security team needs as "evidence" vs. "reference."
- SIG/CAIQ: which sections require vendor-completed answers vs. your internal review? If you want Redwoods to fill the CAIQ, we can return a completed PDF in ~5 business days.
- DPA: we attached our standard DPA redline for review. Primary question for you: acceptable default retention window for customer data (we propose 13 months for hosted pilot; EU customers requiring longer residency should be discussed).
- Logs & exports: what's the required deletion/export timeframe after contract termination? We generally support export & deletion windows (export first 30 days, deletion within 60 days) but can adjust for enterprise needs.

Can your security + legal owners confirm: 1) sprint for evidence intake (dates), 2) DPA redline owners and required retention term, and 3) whether a completed SIG/CAIQ is required prior to pilot provisioning?

Attachments referenced: redwood_soc2-evidence-matrix.xlsx, proposed-mpa-v1.pdf

Appreciate a quick alignment — if you prefer a short call to walk through the matrix, I can set up 30 minutes tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fidorbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Mueller <tom.mueller@fidorbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2025 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: MPA: acceptance cadence + SOC 2/SIG archive questions

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. We reviewed with Security & Legal. High-level responses below and a couple of clarifying questions.

1) Target close: 2025-12-24 is aggressive but possible if the MPA and DPA are agreed this week and Legal receives final signoff via DocuSign by 12/18.

2) SOC 2 artifacts:
- Required evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), control mapping for encryption/key mgmt, and the most recent penetration-test summary.
- Reference only: internal ops runbooks and day-to-day run logs (we will accept snapshots).

3) SIG/CAIQ: We require a vendor-completed CAIQ for our procurement review before pilot provisioning. If you can return the completed form by 12/12, that should be fine.

4) DPA / retention: Our legal preference is 24 months for retention of transaction metadata and 13 months for application logs; however, for a pilot we can accept 13 months blanket if both sides record the pilot scope in the MPA and agree to revisit for production. I've attached our internal DPA redline (fidor_dpa_draft_v2.docx) — please review section 6 (Retention & Deletion) and confirm.

5) Export & deletion window: Fidor requires a data export capability within 30 days of termination and deletion confirmation within 90 days. Can Redwood provide deletion certificates for EU customers?

Proposed evidence sprint: 2025-12-08 -> 2025-12-12 (we'll assign two owners from Security and one from Legal). If Redwood can push the CAIQ and SOC artifact snapshots by 12/12, we should be able to meet the DocuSign sign date above.

Best regards,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement (FinTech Partnerships)
FidorBank
elena.rossi@fidorbank.com
Attachment: fidor_dpa_draft_v2.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fidorbank.com>, Tom Mueller <tom.mueller@fidorbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MPA: acceptance cadence + SOC 2/SIG archive questions

Elena — thanks for the quick review and the proposed sprint window. Internal alignment from our side:

- Redwood will commit to the evidence sprint 2025-12-08 -> 2025-12-12. Deliverables we will aim to upload by 12/12: SOC 2 redacted report, control mapping (encryption & KMS), penetration-test executive summary, and a completed SIG/CAIQ (fillable PDF).
- On the DPA retention ask: for the pilot we can accept 13 months as discussed; for production we prefer to keep standard 13 months and evaluate extensions via a contract annex. If Fidor requires 24 months for specific transaction metadata, we can scope that as a product-level option and document it in the MPA as a configurable retention tier.
- Deletion certificates: we can provide deletion confirmation logs and a signed attestation for export/deletion actions within 90 days. For EU residency-sensitive exports we recommend the Private deployment, which we can provision under a separate SOW if required.

Action items I will take:
1) Upload SOC artefacts + completed CAIQ to the shared Drive by EOD 12/12.
2) Prepare a one-page MPA appendix that records the pilot retention carveout (13 months) and the escalation path if Fidor requests 24 months for production.

Marissa / Kimberly — I'll coordinate the HubSpot deal update and the DocuSign room. Elena / Tom — if you confirm the sprint owners we will send calendar invites for the intake sessions.

Thanks,
Karthik
Solutions Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — short confirmation from Security.

We accept the evidence sprint 2025-12-08 -> 2025-12-12. Please ensure the CAIQ is completed and that Redwood's SOC 2 redacted report includes the encryption/KMS control mapping.

On retention: pilot = 13 months across the board, documented in the MPA appendix. Production retention tiers will be part of the commercial SOW; we'll work with Redwood product to confirm feasibility for a 24-month transaction metadata tier.

DocuSign: once the DPA redline is updated (Marissa/Karthik), Legal asks that you send the final DPA + MPA appendix through DocuSign and include the following signers: FidorBank Legal (internal counsel), FidorBank Head of Payments (Tom Mueller), Redwood Legal (signature block). I'll open the DocuSign room once we receive the final files.

Quick checklist for the sprint owners: 
- Redwood: SOC2 redacted report, control mapping, CAIQ (completed)
- Fidor: designate Security owner (email) and Legal reviewer.

I'll set up a 15-min sync on 12/08 09:00 CET to kick off the intake. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FB-2025-089
